phase_policies.applies_when: Around 3 minutes, heavy economy, moderate production, Reaper scouting, enemy ground posture with Zergling/Queen, moderate production, light tech.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck if enemy shows early pressure or tech switch.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Develop economy and tech, strengthen ground, maintain production.
phase_policies.target: Continue developing economy and technology while strengthening ground army; maintain current production.
phase_policies.title: Early Tech Development with Ground Strength
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to early aggression or neglect scouting for tech switches.

phase_policies.applies_when: Around 4-6 minutes, heavy economy and production, ground forces (Marine, Reaper, Hellions), enemy ground posture with Zergling/Queen, moderate production, light-to-moderate tech.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck if enemy shows signs of heavy pressure or tech switch (e.g., Mutalisks).
phase_policies.routing_summary: Develop economy and tech, strengthen ground, maintain defense and production.
phase_policies.target: Continue developing economy and technology while strengthening ground army; maintain defense and production.
phase_policies.title: Expansion with Ground Macro and Heavy Tech
phase_policies.veto: Do not expand too greedily without defense or over-commit to attacks before composition is solid.

phase_policies.applies_when: Around 7-9 minutes, heavy economy and production, Siege Tanks, Marines, Hellions, enemy ground posture with Zergling/Queen, heavy production and tech.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck if enemy shows signs of air transition or heavy pressure.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Strengthen ground, increase tech, maintain economy and defense.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening ground army and increase technology; maintain economy and defense.
phase_policies.title: Ground Strength with Siege Tanks and Tech
phase_policies.veto: Do not over-invest in air without scouting or neglect upgrades.

phase_policies.applies_when: Around 10 minutes, strong ground army with Siege Tanks, Marines, Hellions, heavy production and tech, enemy ground posture with Zergling/Queen, heavy production and tech.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck if enemy shows signs of air transition or heavy pressure.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Strengthen ground, increase tech, maintain economy and defense.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening ground army and increase technology investment; maintain economy and defense.
phase_policies.title: Late-Midgame Ground Dominance with Tech
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect scouting for tech switches or over-commit to a single composition.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
